title: 3.3.1.3-dev crashes when (de-)selecting the Insulin button
body:
With the dev version (1985) the app restarts everytime when I:
- click on the preferences button to show Insulin button
- click on the preferences button to deactivate the insulin button

It the same behaviour no matter whether SMB or AUTOISF plugin is active.

Unfortunately I cannot find any trace of any logfile for the last 3 days. Was there a further increase in file protection?

comments.body:
The other 3 buttons work fine.
I have a virtual pump (Accu-Chek Combo) selected.

More weird observations:
When I activate all 4 buttons the next time I want to de-activte any then the Carb button is not in the regular list but moved further down. I wonder whether it is related to the overlay of the Treatment button with the dev version indicator.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f0ee2594-d420-4f6c-bfaf-fbd493c7eef6)

Ah. Found the issue: I have selected "**Dark theme**"
When I select "Light theme" version does show on overview and in preferences.

Knowing this I can now see faintly the black colored version text:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb5623a8-97d3-484f-94a9-f28366122882)
On my Samsung it shows in clear red in all 3 themes. Also, on virtual Pixel8 in Studio it is visible in red in standard theme.

> On my Samsung it shows in clear red in all 3 themes. Also, on virtual Pixel8 in Studio it is visible in red in standard theme.

Hmmm... S22 Ultra. Version text shows in plain black (dark theme0 or grayisch (light them)
(No special display settings. Tried switching AAPS between theme's and skins)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a0c4e390-a6ee-4ace-8adf-24e5b22481d8)

it should be 
gray when commited
orange when expired
red when uncommited

> it should be gray when commited ...

Ah - that explains. So the color selection is as expected (only running clean dev build on this phone).

But actually, this gray is of similar "gray" used for background when in Dark mode.
Maybe than the gray (text) should have the same color-code used for other "gray" items in overview?

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c92c37c-040e-4d33-b76e-acd1a36f8f38)

Ok, did some more testing:
When in AAPS 3.3 dev version text shows OK (gray on white background) on all my phones when in AAPS Light mode.

In AAPS dark mode (background color dark gray):
- OK on a Nokia 5.4 test phone (version text light-grey, same color as other UI elements)
- Hardly visible: Black on dark gray AAPS background on Samsung Note 9 (flashed Lineage OS, Android 13)
- Hardly visible: Black on dark gray AAPS background on Samsung S22 Ultra (Android 14, One UI 6.1, latest updates)

Looks like this depends on Display hardware, specific for text on the Samsung Display?
Still, strange that on the Samsung phones version text is colored "black", not gray-ish as expected. All other UI elements show gray colors as expected.

This testing is going more and more mysterious. For latest dev

* on my Samsung S24+ (Android14, One UI 6.1) in  Dark Mode is visible as specified, in Light Mode not visible
* on my Samsung S20FE (Android13, One UI 5.1) in  Dark Mode is visible as specified, in Light Mode not visible
* on Pixel 8 in Meerkat (API 33) in Dark Mode is not visible; in Light Mode is visible  as specified
* on Pixel 9 pro in Meerkat (API 34) in Dark mode is not visible; in Light Mode visible as specified
This morning I got an idea. Besides dark and Light there is device theme. That displays always because it so happens, that it is Dark for my Samsungs and Light for the virtual Pixels in Meerkat.

@vanelsberg Looks Iike I don't have the required permisson for re-opening.
@MilosKozak Although probably not exactly related to the original crash issue it appears that one last change will settle the readability problem.
i reopened but i don't know how to help. for me it works well

The trouble is that devs are interested in the message but users don't care and we cannot persuade them to select another device theme. How about changing the _commited color_ to something different from grey, let's say green or blue. For me at least the uncommited red shows in all themes.

> i reopened but i don't know how to help. for me it works well

Have a fix. Needs review/testing....
https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3879

#3879 seem to work fine. I don't experience any crash in latest dev, didn't before either for that matter. :)

I also didn't have any issues reading the version-number before this PR (Samsung galaxy S10 and Z Flip 4)
